reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate integration
reauth_confirm.description: GoTo SMS needs you to sign in to GoTo again.

abort.missing_credentials: Application credentials are missing. Add your GoTo OAuth client under Application Credentials first.
abort.missing_configuration: The component is not configured. Please follow the documentation.
abort.no_url_available: No URL available. For information about this error, [check the help section]({docs_url})
abort.oauth_unauthorized: OAuth authorization error while obtaining access token.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: This GoTo account does not match the one being reauthenticated.

application_credentials.description: Create an OAuth client in the GoTo Developer Portal with the redirect URI `{redirect_url}` and the `messaging.v1.send` scope, then enter its client ID and secret here.

init.title: Voice calls (optional)
init.description: Needed only for goto_sms.call_tts. Find these in GoTo Admin > Devices > Add Device > SIP Device. Leave everything blank to turn voice off.

data_description.sip_server: Usually reg.jiveip.net (shown as the SIP server/registrar on the device page).
data_description.sip_proxy: Account-specific, e.g. youraccount.jive.rtcfront.net. Required for most accounts; shown as the outbound proxy on the device page.
data_description.sip_password: Leave blank to keep the current password.

error.sip_incomplete: Enter both the SIP username and password, or leave both blank to turn voice off.

sip_not_configured.message: Voice calls are not configured; add SIP details in the integration options.

send_sms.name: Send SMS
send_sms.description: Send an SMS via GoTo Connect (supports templates).

message.name: Message
message.description: The SMS message to send (supports templates).

target.name: Target phone number
target.description: The phone number to send the SMS to (with country code).

sender_id.name: Sender phone number
sender_id.description: The GoTo phone number to send the SMS from (with country code).

call_tts.name: Call with text-to-speech
call_tts.description: Place a phone call through GoTo SIP and read the message aloud. Requires SIP details in the integration options.

tts_engine.name: TTS engine
tts_engine.description: Text-to-speech engine; defaults to the default engine.

language.name: Language
language.description: Language code for the engine, e.g. en-US.

ring_timeout.name: Ring timeout
ring_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for an answer (5-60).
